validity.recommendation: Keep the row. Check the start year (1999 on the sheet against 1990 to 1998 in one source) and find a length.
validity.researcher_notes: The line is real. A 2015 Russian trade outlet and a 2022 Ukrainian outlet both name it, call it a DN 1000 trunk gas pipeline, and report damage on it. It is not a duplicate: no other roster row runs Kramatorsk to Donetsk to Mariupol, and P5989, P7817 and P7818 are on the coastal Taganrog to Berdyansk corridor. Open caveat: the 2015 report says it was built from 1990 to 1998, while the sheet says 1999. Length and capacity are still blank and nothing found states them. Operator for the occupied sections is undocumented.

Searched Russian and Ukrainian news and the operator history for a commissioning year. The only dated statement found is the 2015 Neftegaz report, which says the line was built from 1990 to 1998. That points to 1998 or earlier, not 1999. No second source found. Value stays unconfirmed.

Searched Russian and Ukrainian news and general web for the length in kilometers. Neither news report gives it. The Soviet design institute table and operator pages (tsoua.com returns 403) were not found to list this line. Not filled.
Searched the same news and web sources for design capacity. None states it. Not filled.

Not filled on purpose. The line runs through Donetsk and Mariupol, which Russia has occupied since 2014 and 2022. The Gas TSO of Ukraine is documented as reacting to damage in March 2022, but no source says who runs the occupied sections today. Searched Russian and Ukrainian news and found only distribution-level notices from a Russian-installed gas company.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Newest dated evidence found is the March 2022 Liga.net report of a pressure drop on the operating line after shelling. Searches for 2024 or 2025 reports on this line found nothing that names it. The line crosses Donetsk Oblast, partly occupied, so current flow is unknown. No evidence of decommissioning, so the status stays operating.

summary: real DN1000 trunk, confirmed with caveat; start year 1999 vs 1990-1998 open; length, capacity, operator unresolved
